display.purpose: Greeting and hero session title only.

metric.purpose: Tabular numeric values in display voice.

body.purpose: All interface copy, labels, and data.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs and popovers only; no shadows at rest.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single authored curve: goal arc, bar height, primary action.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action of a viewport.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:4px; background:var(--color-accent); color:var(--color-accent-foreground); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color 200ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Quiet companion action with a hairline border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12px; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; transition:color 140ms ease, border-color 140ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color:var(--color-text); border-color:var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Standard form field with visible focus and error states.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; color:var(--color-text); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12px; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:6px; background:var(--color-surface-2); color:var(--color-text); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; outline:none; transition:border-color 140ms ease, box-shadow 140ms ease; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:var(--color-accent); box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.5; cursor:not-allowed; }

components.name: Flat Card
components.description: Borderless at rest; hairline panel when a boundary is needed.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:24px; border:1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius:16px; background:transparent; color:var(--color-text); } .ds-card-title { margin:0 0 12px; font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:18px; font-weight:700; } .ds-card-body { margin:0; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:14px; line-height:1.5; }

components.name: Week Bar Metric
components.description: Seven real day-values; the current day is the only amber bar.
components.css: .ds-metric { padding:20px 16px; min-width:0; } .ds-metric-label { display:block; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:.08em; text-transform:uppercase; } .ds-metric-value { display:block; margin-top:6px; color:var(--color-text); font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:36px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-.03em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-metric-unit { color:var(--color-muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:12px; font-weight:500; } .ds-metric-bars { display:flex; align-items:flex-end; gap:6px; height:50px; margin-top:16px; } .ds-metric-bars i { flex:1; height:6%; border-radius:4px 4px 0 0; background:var(--color-border-strong); } .ds-metric-bars i.ds-metric-today { background:var(--color-accent); height:100%; transition:height 240ms var(--ease-out); }

components.name: Weekly Goal Arc
components.description: Single circular progress indicator; no duplicate bar.
components.html: 33%
components.css: .ds-goal { position:relative; width:90px; height:90px; } .ds-goal svg { width:100%; height:100%; transform:rotate(-90deg); } .ds-goal circle { fill:none; stroke-width:4; } .ds-goal-track { stroke:var(--color-surface-3); } .ds-goal-fill { stroke:var(--color-accent); stroke-linecap:round; transition:stroke-dasharray 240ms var(--ease-out), stroke 240ms var(--ease-out); } .ds-goal-pct { position:absolute; inset:0; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; font-family:var(--font-display); font-size:18px; font-weight:700; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Sidebar Item
components.description: Active navigation uses a wash and a one-pixel amber filet.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:44px; padding:0 12px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--color-muted); font-family:var(--font-body); font-size:13px; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; transition:background-color 140ms ease, color 140ms ease; } .ds-nav:hover { background:var(--alpha-bg-subtle); color:var(--color-text); } .ds-nav-active { position:relative; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-accent) 12%, transparent); color:var(--color-accent); } .ds-nav-active::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; top:8px; bottom:8px; width:1px; background:var(--color-accent); } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:var(--focus-ring); }

narrative.overview:
Gym Empire is a local-first training log for someone standing in a gym, sometimes distracted, often in a hurry. The interface behaves like an open notebook: one dominant object on the first screen — the session in front of you — and everything else arranged as quiet context around it.

The world is graphite and hairlines. Surfaces are flat at rest; depth comes from scale, weight, spacing, and the occasional one-pixel seam. Colour is rationed to a single amber accent used for action and state. Archivo carries the few large moments; Inter carries every label and control.
keyCharacteristics: One dominant object per viewport; the next session leads the dashboard.
Graphite ground, hairline seams, no decorative background, no shadows at rest.
One amber accent, reserved for action, selection, and state.
Two type voices with strict roles; no display face in labels or controls.
Week-bar metrics instead of equal KPI tiles.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber occupies a small fraction of any screen. It marks action, selection, or change — never atmosphere. If two amber elements compete, one is wrong.

rules.name: The State-Colour Rule
rules.body: Success, destructive, warning, and info colours appear only on state indicators, never as decorative data hues.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: A heading carries its own weight. No small uppercase label above it; dates and context live in the top bar or beside the title.

rules.name: The Display-Only Rule
rules.body: Archivo appears only at Display and Metric sizes, never in buttons, inputs, tables, or labels.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: One pixel of border is enough. Give an element more presence through scale or weight, not a heavier edge.

dos: Do lead every screen with one dominant object and one primary action.
Do use Archivo only for display and metric sizes; Inter for everything else.
Do separate with hairlines and space, and keep surfaces flat.
Do keep amber rare and meaningful; verify both themes with pnpm check:contrast.
Do design the empty, loading, error, and singular/plural states before calling a screen finished.
donts: Don't place a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don't ship a row of equal icon-and-number KPI tiles on the dashboard; use week-bar metrics.
Don't add gradients, glow, glass, decorative backgrounds, or shadows at rest.
Don't use coloured icons as the default treatment for data; reserve colour for state.
Don't animate a page load. Motion reports state changes only, with --ease-out.
Don't invent claims, credentials, or data; label estimates honestly.
